integrity: Exact analytical argument with separately reproducible finite algebra tests; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Filippov convexification at polygonal vertex rays, regular N-gon, constant positive omega/lambda, zero mu, nonzero initial state. Does not assert equivalence to transversal hybrid switching, general polygon shapes, or individual asymptotic exponents. Earlier 2011 and 2012 exact-priority risk remains because full texts inaccessible.
title: Sharp global radial contraction and sliding transients for regular-polygon Filippov oscillators
